gameplayFunction: fast-firing player defense turret with unmistakable forward aim, interaction socket, and escalating damage readability
oneSecondRead: This planted twin-barrel machine aims forward, fires rapidly, exposes a safe-side interaction socket and clearly loses capability as damage escalates.
worldRole: A rapid-response player defense that converts aim, coverage and sustained fire into a readable fortress hypothesis.
emotionalIntent: Alert, energetic and reassuring when active; damage should feel mechanically specific and urgently repairable.

orientation.front: Two aligned fast barrels, protected apertures and a clear forward wedge sit above a compact planted pedestal.
orientation.playerSide: A complete protected socket sits below the weapon body on the player-safe side and opens when disabled.
orientation.threatSide: Player-safe weapon readiness is distinguished from enemy threat; barrel posture and service state carry damage readability.

interactionZones.requiredCue: Broad base and short pedestal. Dark grounded mass. Color role: primary.

interactionZones.purpose: Show aim, readiness and weapon function.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Two parallel barrels and forward apertures. Readable metal separation. Color role: bareMetal.
Complete protected socket when usable. Small high-contrast focal point. Color role: interaction.

interactionZones.purpose: Show exactly which firing or support capability failed.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Dropped barrel, opened guard, tilted upper mass and exposed core. Warning then critical contrast at causal failure. Color role: warning.

collisionPromise: Keep the bottom_center pivot, footprint and gameplay anchors identical in every generated state.
obligations: Reconstruct every primary and secondary component defined by this canon.
Produce every required state from the same component structure and stable anchors.
Preserve the one-second function, front, interaction, danger and state readings.
Record this canon ID and exact SHA-256 in the compliance envelope.
constraints: Dimensions are 4.8 x 5.4 x 5.2 studs with tolerance 0.005.
Pivot is bottom_center and component anchors remain stable.
One UV set and one material slot maximum per production mesh component.
freedoms: service_detail: one approved cooling, feed or repair motif per territory. Adds construction identity without changing function.
muzzle_guard_profile: territory-approved rectangle or trapezoid family. Expresses DA while preserving twin-barrel recognition.
idle_tracking_phase: bounded phase and speed only. Prevents synchronized defenses while preserving readiness.
prohibitions: friendly socket on the firing face
needle barrels or thin loose wires
damage shown only by emissive color
new palette, material, angle, bevel or damage language
decorative repair with no causal reason
more than three visible material families
literal construction-toy motifs or pristine molded-plastic identity
